assertion_audit.failure_condition: The missing-values assertion fails when a generating-state literal, tabulated current/flux/axis, stored q sign or q_95_dd number is deleted or changed independently of receipt data; it does not rerun generation.

The quote assertion fails on changed printed derived current, axis, flux or q gaps; verdict presence/absence assertions fail if the old four-of-five verdict returns or stale 0.42 percent returns; the sentence assertion fails on definitional-share prose lacking 0.083; q gap and four physical-band inequalities fail if receipt values cross their stated thresholds or the stored cross-definition gap ceases to exceed q95 tolerance.

The projection assertion fails if a saved amplitude no longer equals the projection of raw profile samples; quote coverage fails if pressure/diamagnetic amplitudes or fractional trades change only in the fragment.

Quote coverage fails for independently changed coefficients, singular values, residuals, axis or current; convergence assertions fail if the control is labelled converged in data or prose; stale-number exclusions fail if 1.6e-4 or 14.995 returns.

Fails if the published control-current fraction, fit-current fraction, flux-span ratio or control q no longer matches recomputation from raw receipt states; no direct independent solver replay is performed.

Fails when live-count or design-rank receipt strings disappear from the fragment, or the generic configuration-read phrase disappears; the latter is a weak wording guard and does not establish solver provenance on its own.

Fails if the eight LLS records are absent or have another basis, first/final iterations or ranks change, the first full line or final rank is unquoted, or first design no longer has m=87/path=bvls; removing basis_log was observed red in the recorded control.

Fails if any displayed calculator value, axis/boundary flux or gap is absent; differences fail if either cached gap disagrees with independent state rows; limit fails for gap above tolerance; cross/share assertions fail if arithmetic no longer rounds to 0.148/0.083 or those values disappear; stored-value quote assertions fail on missing stored q values. The inflated-gap control fails without changing the rows.

Fails if configured degree/live count/regime or per-family design ranks lose their expected on/off values, any of four log lines is omitted, profile node count ceases to be 65, constrained endpoints become nonzero, unconstrained endpoints become zero, or axis/control endpoint values disappear; recorded count and endpoint mutations each fail.
Fails on repeated fragment HTML ids; reverting the unique nova-fit-output id recreates a duplicate.

Fails for missing/implausibly small/non-SVG panels, unlabelled generating or reconstructed state, a missing fragment image reference or a changed drawing digest; a volatile date-only edit is intentionally excluded by the owner digest.
Fails if the fragment loses receipt.json or the named test path; it is a citation-presence guard, not evidence of execution.
Fails on closing a paragraph without an open one, nested opening, or an unclosed final paragraph; reinstating the earlier orphan close reddens it.
Fails if any counted section/p/table/figure/pre/tbody/thead/tr opening and closing counts differ; balanced misnesting can still pass this counting check.

assertion_independence: No assertion compares a value to the same variable supplied to a production call: there is no production call under test. Fragment text and frozen receipt values are distinct inputs, and recomputed gaps/projections compare different fields. They protect evidence reconciliation, not the correctness of either future solver; jointly rewriting a receipt and its prose can preserve consistency and requires human review.
call_site_search: The complete net diff adds only HTML, two SVG panels, JSON receipt data and a test module; no nova/, scripts/, or benchmarks/ runtime definition is added or changed, so there is no production caller of added runtime code. The production solver usages named by the evidence are existing FluxSurfaceGeometry.from_flux_map and the inverse-class runner in the source run, not newly landed production definitions.
